_comment: Single source of truth for gray-area's local tool dependencies. Consumed by the shared toolchain probe, used by /prosthetic-conscience:doctor. Gray Area reads trajectories that the harness already writes; it needs no external tool of its own yet.

tools.name: git
tools.purpose: version control; inspections are declared against a tracked tree

_hook_binaries._comment: OUR compiled hooks, not external deps — one per directory under tools/cmd/. /prosthetic-conscience:doctor --fix fetches the CI-built release asset <name>_{goos}_{goarch}{exe} (SHA256-verified) into bin/, falling back to go build only as a dev convenience. hooks.json invokes ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/<name>.

binaries.name: gray-area-capture
binaries.purpose: records one manifest row per seat naming that seat's own agent_transcript_path — an index, never a copy of conversation content; never blocks the subagent
